versions.content: Error handling if an Ethernet frame could not be identified as match for an EthCtrlConfigEgressQueue Status: DRAFT If an Ethernet frame could not be identified as match to be enqueued in any configured EthCtrlConfigEgressQueue at the same Ethernet controller, then the Ethernet frame shall be dropped and a runtime error with error code ETH_E_NO_MATCHING_- EGRESS_QUEUE_IDENTIFIED shall be reported.
